### Manasseh’s Reign of Terror
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/Manassehs-Reign-of-Terror
Passage: 2 Kings 21:11-12
Points:
- Despite the godly heritage of his father Hezekiah, King Manasseh led Judah into horrific apostasy, idolatry, and violence.
- Judah’s rebellion became so severe that they exceeded the wickedness of the Canaanite nations God had driven out before them.
- In response, the Lord announced through His prophets that unavoidable calamity and exile would overtake Jerusalem.
- Manasseh’s story shows that God’s patience, while immense, is not limitless and that persistent rebellion brings judgment.
- Believers are warned never to presume upon divine grace but to repent immediately when called by God.
